definitions.explanation: A specific case or occurrence used to illustrate or explain something.

examples.japanese: {例|れい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧。
⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{例|れい}です。
{例|れい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}します→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: I will explain using an example.

notes:
{例|れい} means an example, instance, or precedent. One of the most common nouns in academic, professional, and everyday language.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {例|れい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挙|あ}げる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧: to give an example
- ⟦{例|たと}えば→例えば：00999_tatoeba⟧: for example (different reading: たとえば)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{例|れい}: an example of ~
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{例|れい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take ~ as an example
- {例|れい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: unprecedented

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{例外|れいがい}→例外：03798_reigai⟧: exception
- ⟦{例文|れいぶん}→例文：19450_reibun⟧: example sentence
- ⟦{実例|じつれい}→実例：04217_jitsurei⟧: actual example, real case
- ⟦{用例|ようれい}→用例：13578_yourei⟧: usage example
- ⟦{前例|ぜんれい}→前例：11790_zenrei⟧: precedent
- ⟦{慣例|かんれい}→慣例：12679_kanrei⟧: custom, convention

SPECIAL USAGE:
{例|れい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ can mean "that (thing we both know about)" — an indirect way to refer to something without naming it directly: {例|れい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧ (that matter we discussed).
